human_verification.supporting_evidence: The crop work produced independent support for the extractor's behaviour on these tables: glyphs overflow their declared column by up to 36pt (measured on page 784, cause text x0=70.4..164.4 against a declared cell of 106.3..181.3), and pdfplumber and PyMuPDF agree on what lies inside the rectangle. That is consistent with the extractor reading the tables correctly. It is NOT a substitute for a human reading, because both libraries share the same notion of a cell.
